en: Sepia-toned vintage view of a wide cobblestoned market square bordered by multi‑storey historic buildings. On the left are townhouses with shops at street level; on the right is a long building with a steep roof, exterior staircase, and small tower. Several people walk across the open square toward a fountain in the center background. At the top in red print is the caption identifying the location as the marketplace of Grimma.
